headline: Sensex and Nifty Fall for 6th Week Amid Rising Crude Oil
why: Crude oil prices surpassed $100 due to Saudi Arabia export disruptions.
Concerns over upcoming US Fed rate hikes impacting global market sentiment.
Tata Sons and group stock volatility adding pressure on benchmark indices.
Persistent sell-off causing Nifty to fall for six consecutive weeks.
whatHappening: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended mixed amid global macroeconomic triggers.
Goldman Sachs highlighted HFCL and Polycab India among seven key AI enabler stocks.
Derivatives analysts marked 23,050 as key support level for Nifty.
Paytm and NSE IPO news keep financial sector stocks in focus.

summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty recorded their sixth straight week of decline due to surging crude oil prices above $100 and US Fed policy concerns. Selected stocks like HFCL and Polycab saw positive attention after being named in Goldman Sachs' AI enabler list. Analysts maintain 23,050 as key Nifty support while Tata stocks and Paytm remain in focus.
